```{=typst}
#let icon-badge(glyph) = box(
	stroke: (paint: rgb("#c9d2dc"), thickness: 0.8pt),
	fill: rgb("#f5f7fa"),
	radius: 999pt,
	inset: (x: 11pt, y: 6pt),
)[
	#text(size: 12pt, fill: rgb("#1f2933"))[#glyph]
]

#let image-badge(path) = box(
	stroke: (paint: rgb("#c9d2dc"), thickness: 0.8pt),
	fill: rgb("#f5f7fa"),
	radius: 999pt,
	inset: (x: 8pt, y: 6pt),
)[
	#image(path, width: 15pt)
]

#align(center, [
	#v(6%)
	#image-badge("/assets/icon-top.png")
	#h(2.2em)
	#icon-badge("⬢")

	#v(1.8em)
	#text(size: 12pt, fill: rgb("#666666"))[{{< meta cover-subtitle >}}]

	#v(1.2em)
	#text(size: 30pt, weight: "bold")[{{< meta cover-title >}}]

	#v(1em)
	#text(size: 16pt, fill: rgb("#333333"))[{{< meta cover-tagline >}}]

	#v(2.2em)
	#box(
		width: 74%,
		stroke: (paint: black, thickness: 0.8pt),
		inset: 12pt,
	)[
		#text(size: 11pt)[742 Evergreen Terrace\\Springfield, IL 62704]
	]

	#v(0.9em)
	#box(
		width: 74%,
		stroke: (paint: black, thickness: 0.8pt),
		inset: 12pt,
	)[
		#text(size: 11pt)[1890 Harbor View Drive\\San Diego, CA 92101]
	]

	#v(2.4em)
	#text(size: 12pt)[{{< meta author >}}]
	#v(0.6em)
	#text(size: 11pt, fill: rgb("#666666"))[{{< meta date >}}]

	#v(2.5em)
	#icon-badge("◎")

	#v(1.8em)
	#text(size: 10pt, fill: rgb("#777777"))[{{< meta cover-footer >}}]
])

#pagebreak()
```
